application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

qualification.details: BS-MS/M.Sc. / M.Tech. in Physics, Applied Physics, Photonics, Optics, or a closely related discipline, with a consistently good academic record as per IIT Ropar norms. Valid CSIR-UGC NET/ GATE or an equivalent national-level qualification. Sound understanding of electromagnetic theory and optics, with a keen interest in metamaterials and metasurfaces. Hands-on experience with electromagnetic simulation tools (CST Studio Suite, COMSOL Multiphysics, Ansys Lumerical/FDTD, MEEP). Familiarity with nanofabrication and/or optical and infrared characterization techniques. Programming skills (MATLAB, Python) for modelling and data analysis. Prior research experience or publications in photonics/optics will be an added advantage.

salary_details.details: ₹37,000/- per month + HRA (10%) as applicable, strictly as per ANRF norms.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Ropar Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Ropar JRF position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 31st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a BS-MS/M.Sc. / M.Tech. in Physics, Applied Physics, Photonics, Optics, or a related discipline, along with a valid CSIR-UGC NET/GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of ₹37,000/- along with 10% House Rent Allowance (HRA) as applicable.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the IIT Ropar JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your detailed CV, cover letter, mark sheets, degree certificates, and NET/GATE scorecard to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an online interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a project-based research position at IIT Ropar.

faq.question: Q8. What specific knowledge is required for this JRF role?
faq.answer: A sound understanding of electromagnetic theory and optics, with a keen interest in metamaterials and metasurfaces, is essential.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any additional skills that would be beneficial?
faq.answer: Experience with electromagnetic simulation tools, nanofabrication, optical characterization, and programming skills (MATLAB, Python) are considered advantageous.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Ropar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar is located in Rupnagar, Punjab, with the pincode 140001.
